description: Create a new text note in PinMark. Content is Markdown. Alternatively create it from a template (template id from list_templates); a template cannot be combined with content. The note is not put on the desktop unless open is true (or pin_note is called later); isPinned in the result tells. Returns the new note.

color.description: Preset color name (yellow, blue, green, pink, purple, gray, white) or hex; custom colors require Pro. Overrides the template's color.

open.description: Also put the new note on the desktop and bring it to the foreground (activates PinMark). Default false.

paper.description: Paper for text notes: plain, lined, dotted, microgrid, grain (free); rice, linen, watercolor, recycled, plum, sakura, constellation, topographic, geometric, fireworks, snowflakes (Pro). Overrides the template's paper.

template.description: Template id from list_templates. Its variables are filled in by PinMark.

title.description: Optional title; if omitted PinMark derives one from the content.

name: create_note

ref.description: The exact pinmark-asset:/// address in content; keep it intact when editing.

content.description: Verbatim Markdown. Base every edit on this field.

nextOffset.description: Pass as imageOffset to read further tiles; null after the last tile.

images.description: Tile metadata; the pixels are in the image content blocks, in this order.

error.description: Set when this tile could not be encoded; the image block is then omitted.

index.description: Stable tile index within the whole image.

region.description: Pixel range of this tile on the original image; adjacent tiles overlap.

isDeleted.description: Whether the note is in the trash.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the desktop (its desktop window is open).

visibleText.description: Readable text with markup removed. For reading only; never write it back.

title: Create note
